title: Hiding Banner Ads On a Specific Static Page | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Hiding Banner Ads On a Specific Static Page Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000054624 If ads have been set up on the website but need to be hidden on a specific static page for members, follow the steps below. Navigate to My Content > Web Page Builder . Select the page where the ads should be hidden and click "Edit" : Click Page Options and select Hide Banner Ad Modules .
